name: Chilling Aura
body:
School transmutation [cold]; Level druid 3, ranger 3, shaman 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Area 10-ft. radius
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Fort negates; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You freeze the air around you, frost dancing across their features. When you cast this spell frost seems to hang in the air around you. You gain fire resistance 20 and all creatures within 10 feet of you take 4d6 cold damage and become fatigued at the beginning of their turn. A successful Fortitude save halves the damage and negates the fatigued condition.
